## DriverFactory type

Builds a driver from the context its manager resolved at construction.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type DriverFactory<TDriver, TContext> = (context: TContext) => TDriver | Promise<TDriver>;
```

## Remarks

Factories may be synchronous. A memory store has nothing to await, and forcing it to return a promise would make the simplest driver the most awkward to write.
